created is the actual createFile result; it chooses Created versus Skipped output. Dry-run and existing-file behavior remain with the original workspace template owner.

OpenAI selects the existing API adapter versus injected AgentRunner. Selection copies share the original capacity channel; admitted bindings and caller contexts remain separate. No operation context is stored and no second pool is allocated.
known is observation validity, not a control mode. Missing/negative/overflow observations must preserve unknown accounting instead of emitting a known zero.

Removed the forwarding export and exposed the existing response-recording implementation directly. Host execution, authoring quiz and native quiz adapters call the one implementation; event fields and trace behavior are unchanged.
Bound generation retains operation values and adapters, while each caller derives its own context. A canceled caller cannot poison a later call to the same admitted operation.
Bridge caller derives and defers cancellation; input watcher receives that cancellation handle. Process exchange explicitly owns both bounded spools and retains cancellation/handler boundaries.

These implementations parse and revise the complete WorkspaceConfig image, authorize exact changes and own locked journals/recovery. Pure selection/binding values and retained host lifecycle are direct dependencies, not root aliases.

Runtime asset initialization actually uses the existing workspace profile/template engine and createFile outcomes. Moving this composition into host runtime would import root workspace machinery or invent a generic port.

Preview composes the actual WorkspaceConfig and ExecutionRepository to compare retained run references with filesystem directories. It consumes runtime defaults directly and retains its distinct execution read-model responsibility.

Context materialization composes real execution records, ticket repair handoffs and evidence policy. Runtime supplies its plan and path mapping; this is actual ticket/execution composition, with its assigned signature already fixed.
Workflow validates inherited FD3/FD5, existing slot identity/limit and guarded lock conversion. Runtime holds only shared references to those admitted files; no alternate capacity pool exists.

Native admission composes typed WorkflowCommand and WorkerBinding, validates omitted-command compatibility and preserves workflow conflict errors. Binding hashing and executable checks use their direct owners.
